journeys.purpose: Open the public home page, choose Individual therapy, reach the country question, and verify safe Back recovery.
steps: observe the country question and Next control
use browser Back to recover to home
journeys.expected_result: The local clone renders the same public shell and first onboarding state without sending a source request.
journeys.failure_variant: unknown route returns a local 404; onboarding remains usable when no answer is selected.
journeys.recovery_variant: return to home or use Previous question without persisting source data.

journeys.purpose: Navigate the directly observed public information, editorial, therapist, support and crisis-resource page families from the shared shell.
journeys.expected_result: Each route is local, renders observed headings/content structure, and keeps the shared footer and consent treatment.
journeys.failure_variant: unknown public route renders a local not-found state.

journeys.purpose: Provide local-only sign-in and questionnaire state for clone validation.
journeys.expected_result: Only site-isolated local runtime state changes; no source mutation or external email occurs.
journeys.failure_variant: invalid synthetic credentials render a local error.
journeys.recovery_variant: return to login or reset local fixture.

journeys.purpose: Review the authenticated therapy-process and membership controls after completing the local questionnaire.
steps: review therapy process and communication methods
review membership price and financial-aid entry
save English and Keep me active preferences locally
observe benefit-code failure state without a successful promotion
journeys.expected_result: The local member can review and operate the directly evidenced controls without a source request or an external side effect.
journeys.failure_variant: Unsupported benefit codes fail closed and incomplete questionnaires redirect to the questionnaire.
journeys.recovery_variant: Return to the member area, questionnaire, or log out.

journeys.purpose: Complete the human-confirmed task and the matching expanded-task workflow with synthetic identity and health information.
steps: start sign-up from the public entry
create and locally verify a synthetic account
complete all eight intake steps with synthetic answers
search, filter and sort local providers
save and open a provider detail
compare and choose an available slot
enter booking details and special requests
exercise declined or retryable payment recovery and approve the local sandbox payment
verify confirmation details and persisted history
reschedule or cancel and record a local review/contact action
journeys.expected_result: The confirmation and history reflect the selected provider, package, session mode, slot, synthetic intake snapshot, special request and amount after refresh.
journeys.failure_variant: Required-field, signed-out, declined-payment and retryable-payment states fail closed with actionable recovery.
journeys.recovery_variant: Retry payment, return to provider results, reschedule, cancel, review or contact using local-only state.
